justification: The localisation objection is genuine and distinct from the ground-truth Lie-quotient defect. Concretely, take K=Q(θ), θ³+θ²−2θ−1=0, p=29, and W the augmentation summand of Ind_K^Q Q_29(1). K is cyclic cubic, 29 splits completely, and W is irreducible while its restriction to G_K is scalar. The norm-one unit θ has nonzero local Kummer logarithm ℓ. Its corresponding line W′ is G_K-stable but has zero G_Q-core. Thus ℓ lies in loc H_f¹(W)∩H_f¹(W′) but cannot arise from H_f¹(0), disproving the claimed descent ([cohomological lemma](https://arxiv.org/pdf/1903.05032v3#page=34)).
